name: memento-plugins
description: Memento's official marketplace for Claude Code — persistent AI memory plus tier-specific extras (AGI, Beta).

plugins.name: memento
plugins.description: Persistent AI memory for Claude Code. Your AI remembers your codebase, conventions, and team knowledge across every session.

plugins.name: memento-agi
plugins.description: AGI-tier commands for Memento — autonomous project execution, voice-driven coding, AI code review, tracing. Requires the Memento AGI plan and the base `memento` plugin.

plugins.name: memento-beta
plugins.description: Beta-tier and admin commands for Memento — patrols, voice-diff review, snapshot tooling, command authoring. Requires the Memento Beta plan and the base `memento` plugin.
